children: D-Wave announced it will host Qubits Asia 2026 in Seoul on Oct. 28 to spotlight production applications and advances in its annealing and gate-model technologies.
Full-day Qubits Asia 2026 user conference set for Oct. 28, 2026 in Seoul to accelerate quantum adoption across APAC.
Event will feature D-Wave executives, customers and researchers sharing real-world implementations and best practices.
Conference to showcase updates on D-Wave’s annealing and gate-model technologies and commercial quantum AI progress.
Program includes customer case studies on network optimization, 3D CT inspection, generative AI workflows, semiconductor reticle and port scheduling.
